mapper.select: select q.quote_seq, q.request_seq, q.expert_seq, q.price, r.customer_seq, r.status as request_status, e.name as expert_name, nvl(ep.hidden, 'N') as expert_hidden, nvl((select max(tal.title) from tbl_talent tal where tal.expert_seq = q.expert_seq and tal.category_seq = r.category_seq and tal.enabled = 'Y'), cat.name) as service_name from tbl_quote q inner join tbl_request r on r.request_seq = q.request_seq inner join tbl_member e on e.member_seq = q.expert_seq left join tbl_expert_profile ep on ep.expert_seq = q.expert_seq left join tbl_category cat on cat.category_seq = r.category_seq where q.quote_seq = #{quoteSeq}
mapper.update: update tbl_request set status = 'SELECTED' where request_seq = #{requestSeq} and status in ('OPEN', 'CLOSED') and (select_deadline is null or select_deadline > sysdate)
update tbl_request set status = 'CANCELED' where request_seq = #{requestSeq} and status = 'SELECTED'
mapper.sql: t.trade_seq, t.request_seq, t.quote_seq, t.customer_seq, t.expert_seq, t.price, t.status, to_char(t.regdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as regdate, to_char(t.start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as start_date, to_char(t.delivered_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as delivered_date, to_char(t.confirm_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as confirm_date, to_char(t.cancel_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as cancel_date, c.name as customer_name, e.name as expert_name, nvl((select max(tal.title) from tbl_talent tal where tal.expert_seq = t.expert_seq and tal.category_seq = r.category_seq and tal.enabled = 'Y'), cat.name) as service_name

from tbl_trade t inner join tbl_member c on c.member_seq = t.customer_seq inner join tbl_member e on e.member_seq = t.expert_seq inner join tbl_request r on r.request_seq = t.request_seq left join tbl_category cat on cat.category_seq = r.category_seq
mapper.insert:
select seq_trade.nextval from dual
insert into tbl_trade (trade_seq, request_seq, quote_seq, customer_seq, expert_seq, price, status) values (#{tradeSeq}, #{requestSeq}, #{quoteSeq}, #{customerSeq}, #{expertSeq}, #{price}, 'PAID')
mapper.update: update tbl_trade set status = 'IN_PROGRESS', start_date = sysdate where trade_seq = #{tradeSeq} and status = 'PAID'
update tbl_trade set status = 'DELIVERED', delivered_date = sysdate where trade_seq = #{tradeSeq} and status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
update tbl_trade set status = 'CONFIRMED', confirm_date = sysdate where trade_seq = #{tradeSeq} and status = 'DELIVERED'
update tbl_trade set status = 'CANCELED', cancel_date = sysdate where trade_seq = #{tradeSeq} and status = 'PAID'
mapper.select: select trade_seq from tbl_trade where status = 'DELIVERED' and delivered_date <= sysdate - #{days}
select count(*) from tbl_review where trade_seq = #{tradeSeq}
select count(*) from tbl_trade where expert_seq = #{expertSeq} and status = 'CONFIRMED'
select count(*) from tbl_trade where (customer_seq = #{memberSeq} or expert_seq = #{memberSeq}) and status in ('PAID', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'DELIVERED')
select member_seq, id from tbl_member where member_seq = #{memberSeq} and enabled = 'Y'

select m.member_seq, m.id from tbl_quote q join tbl_member m on m.member_seq = q.expert_seq where q.request_seq = #{requestSeq} and q.quote_seq != #{quoteSeq} and q.status = 'UNSELECTED' and m.enabled = 'Y'
mapper.insert: insert into tbl_trade_file (trade_file_seq, trade_seq, orgname, filename, filesize) values (seq_trade_file.nextval, #{tradeSeq}, #{orgname}, #{filename}, #{filesize})
mapper.select: select trade_file_seq, trade_seq, orgname, filename, filesize, to_char(regdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as regdate from tbl_trade_file where trade_seq = #{tradeSeq} order by trade_file_seq
select trade_file_seq, trade_seq, orgname, filename, filesize, to_char(regdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as regdate from tbl_trade_file where trade_file_seq = #{tradeFileSeq}
